title: Ryanair Initiates Cost Drive to Offset $2 Billion Fuel Surge

title: Blackstone Leads $3.1 Billion Deal to Acquire LNG Canada Stake

title: China’s Mbappé Blackout Continues as Real Madrid Games Dropped
summary: Football star Kylian Mbappé’s match for Real Madrid this weekend was unavailable on both television and digital streaming platforms in China, a sign that the backlash against the French athlete over a perceived insult to Mao Zedong has yet to fully subside.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 2
summary: Oil declined after a report said US President Donald Trump wants to give diplomacy with Iran more time before potentially resuming strikes following Tuesday’s midterm elections.

title: The Icelandic DNA Behind Amgen’s Hunt for the Next Ozempic
summary: Amgen's best chance at breaking into the high-stakes obesity drug market got its start in a basement at the University of Iceland Science Park in Reykjavík, in a freezer chilled to minus-13 degrees Fahrenheit. Bloomberg's Madison Muller explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: South Africa’s Low-Key Municipal Polls Pose Risks for Investors
summary: South Africa’s nationwide municipal elections on Wednesday hold few fears for investors, if market indicators are anything to go by. But shifts in broad support for the major political parties could provide a read on the future of the governing coalition that has steered the country’s fiscal and economic reforms.

title: Japan Extends Transition Bond Push Despite Fossil-Fuel Reliance
summary: Japan sold its fifth climate transition bond of the year, remaining the only government to use the designation despite the country’s increasing reliance on fossil fuels since the start of the war in Iran.

title: US Gulf Allies Confront Escalation Fears
summary: Bloomberg's Jon Herskovitz details Donald Trump’s dual-track Iran strategy, balancing regional diplomatic talks against a US military buildup. Meanwhile, Gulf allies fear renewed strikes could trigger severe Iranian retaliation against critical energy infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Binance Details $3.6 Billion in Net Outflows
